title: The Other Party
text: Another expedition is camped ahead, laughing around the fire, wearing the colours of a House that fell a hundred years ago. Their gear is old-fashioned and new. They wave you over. They have not noticed the time.

options.label: The Leader tells them how long it has been.

outcomes.text: They go very quiet, and give you everything they carry, and walk into the dark one by one.

options.label: Share their fire for the night.

outcomes.text: They tell old stories of your Houses, some true, and laugh at the wrong places.

options.label: The quietest takes their supplies while they sleep.

outcomes.text: Old gold spends just as well. In the morning, their camp is empty, and the fire long cold.
